sources.title: Fragments Of Memories — BLACK/MATRIX 00 プレイ日記
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET A. Directly inspectable 2005 43-entry play diary spanning first clear and later-playthrough/endgame entries. It independently establishes the chronological story/battle flow and observed bonus placement. Newly indexed in this pass: BS2 and BS3 occur during chapter 3; BS4 occurs in chapter 4; BS5 `うちの子2` and BS6 `手合わせ` fire back-to-back in one chapter-4 free-action segment before mandatory progression resumes toward ラムシュタイン大聖堂; BS7/8 occur in chapter 5; BS9 in chapter 6; BS10 then BS11 in chapter 7; BS12 in chapter 8; and BS14 in chapter 9, where `セングラー` is visibly consumed during the added event. Use this as the independent contemporary chronology lane. Exact trigger chains that the diary does not print still require Set B or remain unsupported.

sources.title: たそがれストローク — 〖BLACK/MATRIX 00〗ボーナスシナリオまとめ
sources.notes: OWNER-APPROVED EXCEPTION SUPPORT / DERIVATIVE JAPANESE. Directly inspectable 2020 bonus-scenario memo with all 14 trigger chains and prerequisites. The author states the material was preserved from an older now-vanished site, so it is not independently promoted to normal Set B. On 2026-09-22 the repository owner explicitly approved using the Japanese and Chinese sources already recovered to move forward rather than require further video/archive recovery. Under that title-scoped exception, TSST may corroborate the four residual BLACK/MATRIX trigger gaps together with FFSKY and the already verified Japanese chronology. Its chapter label for BS1 remains rejected because it conflicts with the contemporary Set-A diary and directly inspected FC2 chapter-2 walkthrough.

sources.title: BLACK/MATRIX総合スレッド Chapter:15
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B supplementary/community component. Directly inspectable discussion independently states that the OO bonus-scenario path yields the ring opposed to パスカ's ring, that avoiding/handling that ring matters for the true-ending path, and that the special ending requires a later playthrough. Newly inspected posts 319-321 directly establish the chapter-9 item condition for the クッタ-related event: `セングラーは第９章のクッタ関連のイベントに必要` and, after obtaining it, `「装備」せずにただ所持しておくこと`. This independently verifies the セングラー possession/timing constraint for BS14, but not the BS4+BS7+BS10 prerequisite chain or the exact notebook/waiter trigger. Another post reports checking a physical strategy guide for a late-game item condition. Use cautiously and reconcile with stronger walkthrough evidence.

sources.title: PS～Black/Matrix00徹底攻略+極道研究
sources.notes: SUPPLEMENTAL CHINESE / ENGLISH-REFERENCE LANE ONLY. Directly inspectable detailed full walkthrough. The page author, DARKGUARD, explicitly says the guide was written from his own experience and completed after roughly one month of work; this is therefore an original Chinese walkthrough, NOT the vanished Japanese site later preserved by TSST. It provides chronological battle-stage order, free-action windows, hidden-shop/key-item notes, conditional battle rewards, ending-affecting conditions, and first-clear/NG+ information. Relevant unresolved-trigger material is already captured here: BS2 after 3-1 uses notebook `うちの子` then ダリア; BS3 uses the inn middle-aged man, フライ/プラン, the new notebook entry, then エクサル before optional battle `?1 問答無用`; BS5 uses notebook `うちの子で...` then the waiter; BS6 explicitly lists three Cipher Punk members (young man, woman, man), then notebook `いつものと...`, then ステイエン; BS10 explicitly uses シリア→ウェイトレス→プラン→片翼の天使→ウンダ長老→notebook `記憶を消...`→フライ→`う～ん...`; BS14 says BS4+BS7+BS10 cause notebook `カイン様`, then waiter, then `?4 クッタにトドメを`, whose reward is `絶望の光彩`. The BS6 young-member detail conflicts with derivative TSST (male+female only), and the explicit BS10 waitress placement sharpens TSST's uncertain waiter note, so Japanese corroboration is still required before those progression-critical facts can close the gate. Useful future `enGuide` detail also includes preparing before BS3's strong optional battle, the chapter-4 4-2 optional boss reward (`過酷な抱擁` + `募る思いの告白`), and late chapter-4 Painkiller/AoE cautions. Translate only relevant meaning into concise English. Normally this source is supplemental only. OWNER-APPROVED EXCEPTION (2026-09-22): for the four residual BLACK/MATRIX gaps only, the repository owner explicitly approved using the Japanese + Chinese evidence already recovered rather than continue video/archive recovery. Under that narrow exception, FFSKY may supply the missing trigger/action detail and translated `enGuide` support when combined with the existing Japanese chronology/partial corroboration. It still must never be copied as Japanese text into `jpGuide1`/`jpGuide2`.

sources.title: ブラックマトリクス ダブルオー 公式ガイド
sources.notes: PROVENANCE / OFFICIAL-GUIDE RECOVERY LANE ONLY. Confirms the 2004 Japanese `ブラックマトリクス ダブルオー 公式ガイド` (A5, 175 pages, ISBN 9784797327755); publisher description explicitly says it completely covers all scenario battles including bonus stages. Additional directly inspected resale evidence now confirms the physical first edition and exposes multiple real-book photos (Yahoo Auctions/eBay), but the accessible interior photos show front matter rather than the stage/bonus-scenario pages. Google Books has a bibliographic record but no usable page preview in this environment. Therefore the book still cannot close any missing trigger gap unless a concrete interior scan/photo of the relevant stage pages becomes directly inspectable.

sources.title: BLACK/MATRIX総合スレッド Chapter：10
sources.notes: RESEARCH LEAD PROVENANCE ONLY. Directly inspected thread header from the release-era community. It explicitly links `BLACK/MATRIX 00攻略スレ２` as `http://game9.2ch.net/test/read.cgi/gameover/1086009241/`, proving the dedicated 2004攻略 thread was on the `gameover` board (not `gamesrpg`). The same thread records contemporaneous archive-recovery services such as にくちゃんねる / makimo.to and an old ruku.qp.tc dat2ch mirror pattern. Targeted recovery of thread 1086009241 through native old-2ch/kako paths and currently discoverable mirror/cache families did not yield directly inspectable content in this research environment. This source therefore corrects archival provenance but supplies no trigger fact and closes no gate.

sources.title: ニコニコ動画 — 〖プレイ動画〗ブラックマトリクスOO (mylist/38903044)
sources.notes: HIGH-PRIORITY JAPANESE SET-B CANDIDATE / NOT YET GATE-CLOSING. Independent Japanese no-commentary play-video series `〖プレイ動画〗ブラックマトリクスOO`, playlist `mylist/38903044`, begun in 2013 by a player who states they had played BMOO repeatedly since release and intended to continue the previously incomplete video coverage to the end. Search/Nicozon metadata confirms the series spans the needed chapters and reaches chapter 10. Concrete target parts recovered for focused inspection include chapter 3 `3-4` (`sm22144281`, previous `sm22121454`), chapter 4 `4-1` (`sm22224935`) through `4-5` (`sm22313254`), chapter 7 `7-3` (`sm23977976`), `7-4` (`sm24091204`), `7-5` (`sm24189546`), and chapter 9 `9-4` (`sm24867194`). The current research environment can directly inspect the Japanese video metadata but cannot play/extract the actual gameplay frames, so DO NOT count this source as inspected Set B yet. A browser/session capable of playing NicoNico should inspect only the free-action windows around BS2/3, grouped BS5/6, BS10, and BS14; if the videos visibly perform the trigger chains, record exact observed actions/timing and promote only those directly watched parts into Set B.
